name: edusphere-monorepo
description: EduSphere - Enterprise Learning Management, Course Authoring & Assessment Platform

scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:analytics" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run prisma:generate --workspace=services/api && npm run build --workspace=services/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test:all: npm run test:api && npm run test:analytics && npm run test:security
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/web && npm run lint --workspace=services/api
